evidence: Labeled Tests and modifies unit test structure across src/test/script_tests.cpp and src/test/transaction_tests.cpp.
rationale: Refactors monolithic unit tests into isolated, independent cases to eliminate shared mutable state. As stated in the PR description, this is 'Part of #36692: remove test state that is shared and modified across cases', removing inter-test dependencies where later checks relied on state left by prior checks.
